## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::GovernanceSignaturesInsufficient` — fewer than the required distinct, still-current signatures are recorded.

---

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/governance_test.rs::a_rotation_revokes_what_the_removed_key_half_signed`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/governance_test.rs::a_rotation_revokes_what_the_removed_key_half_signed). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// GovernanceSignaturesInsufficient — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let g = Governed::new();
let id = g.propose_fee(&g.a, 100);
g.f.client.mock_all_auths().governance_sign(&g.a, &id);
g.mature();
Some(rejected!(g
    .f
    .client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .try_governance_execute(&Address::generate(&g.f.env), &id)))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked a_rotation_revokes_what_the_removed_key_half_signed
```

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Collect the required number of distinct signatures from signers still in the current set; a rotation revokes signatures from removed keys.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/rotation-runbook.md#3a-governance-signer-rotation-the-contracts-two-key-set`](../../docs/rotation-runbook.md#3a-governance-signer-rotation-the-contracts-two-key-set)
